category_title: Adolescent students with learning disabilities who under-request accommodations and struggle with the social steps of self-advocacy
scenario_title: Requesting an accommodation in front of peers
minimal_context: The student is requesting an accommodation for an assignment in front of their general education history class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Class, we are going to begin the history assignment now. Grant, do you have a request to make?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looking down at his desk instead of facing the teacher) I need to take this test in the resource room.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. Is there anything else you need to tell me?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Keeping his head down and avoiding eye contact) No, just that I need to go to the resource room.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please tell me the reason you need this accommodation.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns his body away from the teacher, refusing to make eye contact while the rest of the class is listening) I'm not saying it. Just forget it, I'll take it here.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Class, we are going to begin the history assignment now. Grant, do you have a request to make?

STUDENT: (Looking down at his desk instead of facing the teacher) I need to take this test in the resource room.

TUTOR: Okay. Is there anything else you need to tell me?

STUDENT: (Keeping his head down and avoiding eye contact) No, just that I need to go to the resource room.

TUTOR: Please tell me the reason you need this accommodation.

STUDENT: (Turns his body away from the teacher, refusing to make eye contact while the rest of the class is listening) I'm not saying it. Just forget it, I'll take it here.

task.content: Requesting an accommodation in a general education history class
task.learning_goal: implement all five FESTA steps together using accommodations matching their individual needs

context.social_setting: in front of the entire class

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: accommodation was requested in front of the whole class
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: failed to face the teacher, maintain eye contact, or state the reason the accommodation was needed
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: may have felt embarrassed to state the reason

behavior_patterns.condition: Implementing the FESTA steps for requesting accommodations in general education classrooms
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: did not consistently thank the teacher and did not state the reason the accommodation was needed, did not maintain eye contact
